layers.message: Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV export of filtered records
Add integration test for denied exports
Document CSV export in the usage guide

graderOnly: docs/usage.md (Roles line, Exporting records section, CSV format subsection) and README.md accurately describe the implemented POST /records/export route, its filters and validation, the 201 response and headers, the file name and default folder, the CSV format, and administrator-only access (401/403, no file).

Every current acceptance condition (AC-001, AC-002, AC-003) and every technical criterion has sufficient current evidence. AC-003, recorded as pending Documenter in the verification report and the implementation review, is now satisfied by the saved guide recorded in the COMPLETE documentation record.

Implementation and tests are byte-identical to the commit the implementation review assessed (Record CSV export verification); after it only docs/usage.md, README.md, the documentation record, and STATE.md changed.
No material findings, discrepancies, or evidence gaps exist; the final-deliverable review can pass and hand off to Synchronizer.

all.why: final report at the fixed path with matching provenance
the guide condition must be accounted for under its own ID in the final report
the implementation report is preserved byte-identical
Reviewer does not create a synchronization record
normal success hands off to Synchronizer
the next-role invocation for Claude Code

Reviewer must not change git state
the turn-end check finds no new problem

selfChecks.why: the unit suite runs 21 tests as the records state

selfChecks.cmd: pnpm --filter export test:integration 2>&1 | grep -qE 'pass 3$' && pnpm --filter export test:integration
selfChecks.why: the integration script passes with three tests, including the denied-export test

selfChecks.cmd: node -e 'import(`./src/app.ts`).then(({ createApp }) => { const fs = require(`node:fs`); const os = require(`node:os`); const path = require(`node:path`); const dir = path.join(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `deny-`)), `out`); const app = createApp({ exportDir: dir }); const send = (user, query = {}) => app.handle({ method: `POST`, path: `/records/export`, query, user }); const admin = { id: 1, name: `Ada`, role: `admin` }; const bad = send(admin, { status: `deleted` }); const codes = [send(null).status, send({ id: 3, name: `Vik`, role: `viewer` }).status, send({ id: 2, name: `Eli`, role: `editor` }).status, bad.status]; if (codes.join() !== `401,403,403,400` || bad.body !== JSON.stringify({ error: `unknown status: deleted` }) || fs.existsSync(dir)) { console.error(codes); process.exit(1); } if (send(admin).status !== 201 || fs.readdirSync(dir).length !== 1) process.exit(2); console.log(`denied before write`); }, (error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(3); })'
selfChecks.why: AC-002 and the invalid-status contract hold: 401/403/403/400 with no export folder, while an admin export writes one file (implementation review R3)

selfChecks.cmd: node -e 'import(`./src/app.ts`).then(({ createApp }) => { const fs = require(`node:fs`); const os = require(`node:os`); const path = require(`node:path`); const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `cmp-`)); const user = { id: 1, name: `Ada`, role: `admin` }; const crlf = String.fromCharCode(13, 10); for (const query of [{ status: `active` }, { status: `archived` }, { q: `review` }, { owner: `marco`, status: `active` }]) { const app = createApp({ exportDir: dir }); const listed = JSON.parse(app.handle({ method: `GET`, path: `/records`, query, user }).body).records.map((record) => String(record.id)); const exported = app.handle({ method: `POST`, path: `/records/export`, query, user }).body.split(crlf).filter(Boolean).slice(1).map((row) => row.split(`,`)[0]); if (listed.join() !== exported.join() || listed.length === 0) { console.error(query, listed, exported); process.exit(1); } } console.log(`rows match`); }, (error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(3); })'
selfChecks.why: the verification report's E3 comparison is true: exported rows equal GET /records for the same queries

notes: Built on export-project (the code base) rather than the suggested export-reviewing-impl, because this case needs a third, guide acceptance condition (AC-003) that was pending Documenter, and export-reviewing-impl's committed scope, verification report, and handoff have only AC-001/AC-002 with no later-role dependency. Eleven post-install commits replay the export cycle with AC-003 included from the start. 50-context: CONTEXT.md (export-testing's, plus a docs/usage.md line), STATE SCOPING. 52-scope: AC-001 (filtered CSV with RFC 4180 quoting), AC-002 (non-admin/anonymous denied before any file), AC-003 (user guide explains the export, filters, CSV, admin-only access). 54-design: same design as export-testing plus AC-003 No architectural impact (Documenter). 56-plan: APPROVED plan (DEV-001..003 for AC-001/AC-002). 58-export: implementation and tests identical to export-testing's 40-export. 60-complete: plan COMPLETE, STATE TESTING. 62-access-test: the denied-export integration test from export-reviewing-impl. 64-verification: COMPLETE FULL verification with AC-003 as a later-role dependency on Documenter (Open Findings and Dependencies), plus an E3 filter comparison; STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. 66-impl-review: COMPLETE implementation review, no material findings, AC-003 permitted dependency, diagnostic R3 (invalid status 400, no folder); STATE DOCUMENTING. 68-guide: docs/usage.md gains a Roles line, Exporting records and CSV format sections; README links export, lists src/export.ts and test:integration. 70-doc-record: COMPLETE documentation record (AUTONOMOUS, ACTIVE_CHANGE, NONE style, no discrepancies) citing blobs and commits; STATE REVIEWING_FINAL with FORWARD from DOCUMENTING. No final review or synchronization record. Tree clean.
